items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets, change oil and refill coolant
items.note: Use quality updated gaskets; some owners had the leak come back after a cheap repair.

items.t: Won't start with the security light on (Passlock)
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder and relearn anti-theft system

items.t: Front brake rotors warp, causing vibration
items.note: RepairPal prices pads alone at about $230–$287; new rotors add parts cost.

items.t: ABS light comes on over bumps or in turns
items.job: Replace one ABS wheel speed sensor

items.t: Passenger wiper can stop working in snow (recall)
Clunking or popping from the front end
items.note: If a lower control arm is the cause instead, the repair usually costs less.

items.t: Gas pedal hard to press (accelerator cable off the cam)
Key chime won't stop and power locks fail

items.job: Replace door lock actuator, one door

items.t: Horn honks by itself or stops working
items.job: Diagnose horn circuit and replace horn
items.note: If the steering wheel horn switch or airbag module must be replaced, the dealer quoted one owner about $800.
A control or clutch problem can cost much less than a new compressor.
YourMechanic averages $144 for a Cutlass flasher ($49 parts, $95 labor); shop/dealer prices run higher. Based on this estimator, as no parts retailer page was checked.

items.job: Replace exterior door handle, one door
items.note: Cosmetic. Handles are shared with the 1997-2003 Chevrolet Malibu: aftermarket about $20-$60, new OEM $45-$95, plus $100-$150 shop labor per Go-Parts. YourMechanic: $351-$414 for 1997-1999 Cutlass. Multiply for each door.
